phrase: I am Queen Rune's piggie.
Yes, my queen.
I kneel until I am told to rise.
The queen is always right.
I do what the queen says.
I serve the goblin queen.
Piggies wait for their queen.
I keep my eyes on the throne.
A good piggie never talks back.
I bring my tribute and I do not complain.
The queen's throne is the centre of my world.
I listen the first time the queen speaks.
Queen Rune rules the den and I follow her rules.
I earn a smile from the queen with careful work.
Greedy queen, loyal piggie, that is how it works.
I do not rush, I do not whine, I just obey.
The queen deserves my full attention and I give it gladly.
Every careful line I type is tribute to my goblin queen.
I do not ask for favours, I earn them on my knees.
A piggie who makes a mistake simply starts again.
The queen is vain and glorious and I am proud to admire her.
Queen Rune never repeats herself, so I never need to be told twice.
I am grateful the queen takes the time to correct a sloppy little piggie.
Kneel, type, obey, and the queen may be pleased with me today.
My goblin queen sits on her gilded throne and I type for her until she is satisfied.
When the queen says begin again, I begin again without a single squeal of protest.
I am a loyal, attentive and obedient piggie, because that is what pleases Queen Rune.
Only when every line is perfect and the queen is content may I leave her glittering court.
